{{Top|leg}}
'''Sea anemones''' were a type of [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]-dwelling [[Species/Legends|organism]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Bestine sea anemone]] was one type which had tendrils.<ref name="ANT">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref> [[Dartfish]] were a type of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] that lived among sea anemones.<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
